answer_1.quote: We selected four English-to-English core NLG tasks, which are part of several NLG benchmarks and surveys ... Summarization (XSUM40), Question Generation (SQuAD17), Abductive Reasoning (ART10), Style Transfer and Simplification (Shake7).
answer_1.outputs: Generated texts (sentences or paragraphs) for each NLG task

answer_2.quote: We report on various metrics that focus on different aspects, resulting in a more holistic evaluation of the models. To this end, we focus on the lexical similarity metrics, BLEU and ROUGE, the semantic equivalence metric BERTScore (BS) and the statistical modeling metric Perplexity (PPL).

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation involving two annotators. The annotators were asked to rate the generated texts on a five-level scale (see §F.1 below).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated text on a five‑level scale indicating overall quality.
